item: §121 tacking: former (d)(11) repealed 2010 — heir must meet own tests
detail: IRS CCM 201429022: §121(d)(11) was repealed by the 2010 Act (2010-death election only). An heir cannot tack the decedent's use; the heir must meet the 2-of-5 ownership/use tests on their own. The estate may use the decedent's use (Rev. Ruling 2014-18, $250k limit). Model's live-then-sell uses the heir's own 5 years, so numbers are unaffected — counsel to confirm.
